question: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q3 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)

calls.reasoning: Base rate: NVIDIA's next-quarter guide midpoint has been 11.5-15.6% above the just-reported quarter (FY26Q3 54/46.7, Q4 65/57, FY27Q1 78/68.1, Q2 91/81.6, Q3 108/96.2). Recent actuals beat guide by 4.6-5.7%, so Q3 actual ≈ $112-114B (also consistent with Polymarket DC>$105B at ~50%, implying total ≈$113B). Applying 1.10-1.14 gives Q4 guide ≈ $124-130B. Sell-side Q4 consensus ≈ $124.5B, and NVIDIA's recent guides have topped consensus by ~3-4% (Q3: 108 vs 104.2). Upside: Vera Rubin ramp, estimates rising; downside: memory supply constraints, margin compression, China excluded. No human market on the Q4 guide itself; Polymarket Q3 DC-revenue ladder is thin-volume and a near-miss contract (Q3 actuals, not Q4 guide).
calls.dossier:
- Q2 FY27 (Aug 26, 2026 PR): revenue $96.2B (+18% q/q, +106% y/y); Data Center $89.0B; GM 75.0%. Q3 guide $108.0B ±2%, GM 74.0% ±50bp, no China DC compute assumed. Q3 guide vs sell-side consensus at the time ~$104.2B (webull/search summary).
- Q1 FY27 (May 2026 PR, SEC): revenue $81.6B (+20% q/q), DC $75.2B; Q2 guide $91.0B ±2%. Q2 actual beat guide by 5.7%; Q1 actual $81.6B vs $78B guide (+4.6%).
- FY26 history: Q2 actual $46.7B -> Q3 guide $54B; Q3 actual $57.0B -> Q4 guide $65B; Q4 actual $68.1B -> Q1 FY27 guide $78B. Guide/prior-actual ratios: 1.156, 1.140, 1.145, 1.115, 1.123.
- Q3 FY27 consensus revenue ~ $111.4B (MarketBeat/Yahoo, Oct 2026). Q4 FY27 consensus revenue ~ $124.5B, range low ~$117.3B high ~$138.5B (search summary of estimates pages, Oct 2026).
- CFO (Aug 2026 call): gross margin expected to bottom in Q4 at 71-72% due to memory/component costs, 72-73% in FY28 as price increases take effect.
- Vera Rubin production shipments began Aug 2026; mgmt sees Rubin ~20% of DC revenue in FQ3 (tikr, 2026). AWS deal for 2M additional GPUs in 2027-28. FY28 EPS estimates raised ~25% in past 30 days, 7 raises 0 cuts (Oct 2026).
- Oct 31, 2026 newsletter: delivery constraints deepen, memory price hikes squeezing end-markets.
- Earnings date: most sources Nov 17, 2026; one source says Nov 25, 2026.
- Resolution instrument: midpoint of Q4 FY27 revenue in the 'Outlook' section of the Q3 FY27 press release, rounded to nearest $B; NVIDIA customarily gives single figure ±2%.
- Event window: single event, publication of Q3 FY27 PR (~Nov 17, 2026); as of Oct 31, 2026 not yet occurred.
- Searched but not found: direct human prediction market on Q4 guide; buy-side whisper numbers for Q4 guide.

calls.reasoning: Reference class: NVIDIA's recent sequence of next-quarter guidance relative to the prior quarter's actual revenue: Q4FY26 68.1 -> Q1 guide 78 (x1.145), Q1 81.6 -> Q2 guide 91 (x1.115), Q2 96.2 -> Q3 guide 108 (x1.123). NVIDIA has beaten its own guide by $3.6-5.2B. Q3 consensus is $108.8-111.4B and still rising, and the thin Polymarket Q3 Data Center 50% line at $105B implies total revenue near $113B. So Q3 is about $113B and the Q4 guide about 113x1.12 ≈ $127B. Upside: the Rubin ramp and management's 70% FY28 growth outlook. Downside: supply and memory limits and conservative guidance. No market on the Q4 guidance itself was found (Polymarket only has thin Q3 Data Center actual contracts, a near-miss, not an anchor).

Guide increments (13, 13, 17B) extrapolate to ~$127-129B. Sell-side Q4 consensus is ~$124.5B with only upward revisions, and recent guides have come in 3-4% above consensus. calls.reconciliation: All three runs used the same evidence (Q2 actual $96.2B, Q3 guide $108B, consensus Q3 ~$109-111B and Q4 ~$124.5B, guide/actual ratios, beat sizes), and their medians differ by only $0.5B. Factual disputes: (1) earnings date, Nov 17 vs one source saying Nov 25; this doesn't change the value and can't be settled without web access. (2) Q3 consensus, $108.8B vs $111.4B: different aggregators. Either way the implied Q3 actual is ~$112-114B, so the difference doesn't matter. Judgment: the size of the upper tail. A cross-check from the trend in guide increments supports ~$127-129B, so I kept the median at $127B with a slightly heavier upper escape (6%) than runs 1-2 but less than run 3. I agree with and carry forward the runs' reference class and dispersion.
